text.en: Dog owners consistently highlight groomer Nadine for her gentle disposition, warm communication, and reassuring presence. Reviewers note that she takes time to put lively and reactive dogs at ease during grooming sessions. Clients describe her as accommodating and easy to deal with when booking and dropping off pets.

Clients praise the grooming standards, highlighting that dogs return clean, well-trimmed, and smelling fresh after every visit. Several reviews mention neat coats and careful handling of double-coated breeds, poodles, and spaniels. Dog parents express satisfaction with the styling quality and attention to coat hygiene.

Pet owners frequently mention how comfortable their dogs feel in Nadine's care, noting that even shy or excitable pets arrive happy. Reviewers appreciate that she avoids overlapping bookings so reactive dogs do not encounter others. Customers emphasize that pets are treated with genuine affection and calm patience throughout.

q.en: Does So Fetch groom reactive or nervous dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention that Nadine accommodates reactive or shy dogs and spaces bookings to avoid overlapping appointments.

q.en: Are grooming appointments required in advance?

a.en: Yes, grooming sessions must be scheduled in advance, with clients noting prompt communication when arranging booking slots.

q.en: Which dog breeds are accepted for grooming?

a.en: Clients report bringing various breeds including labradors, poodles, spaniels, and pugs for full styling and maintenance.

q.en: Does the salon offer puppy grooming sessions?

a.en: The groomer provides gentle introductory handling and maintenance trims suitable for young and energetic dogs.
